snippet.title: The Dark West - Official Developer Overview Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Join developers at Black Hand for a closer look at The Dark West in this video for the upcoming action RPG that challenges both your skill and sanity. The developers discuss what you can expect from the gameplay and demo for The Dark West, including enemy types, customization, skills, and more. In The Dark West, face a cursed western frontier, where faith and damnation war beneath an eternal dusk. Your choices will carve a path through a world where greed unearthed something fouler than death. The Dark West will be available in Early Access on PC via Steam, and a demo will be available on Steam.
